_comment: WJD stem mirror, train split, pre-encoded from dataset2preencoding/wjd_stems_train.json. No custom_metadata_module: the prompt was written into each sidecar JSON at pre-encode time by custom_md_wjd.py and PreEncodedDataset passes it through as info['prompt']. Whole tracks were encoded, so 'latent_crop_length' 144 (13.3 s) with 'random_crop' picks a different window of each track every epoch; the drums_rms control is cropped in lockstep by PreEncodedDataset. 'controls'/'controls_dim' must match control_keys/controls_dim in the sidecar JSONs (--controls first, then --features at pre-encode). NOTE: the training wrapper (stable_audio_3/training/diffusion.py, _add_streamgen_conditioning) still hardcodes the 'streamgen_latent' control id; it has to be generalised to any modular_local_cond id before this control reaches the model.
